title: Keyboard Manager - Open app: Enhance Window Selection
author: eirikpre

status.label: Actionable Open app enhancement
status.detail: The desired cycling behaviors are concrete, but the prior artifact did not contain an implementation-grade design.

next_action.label: Finish the implementation design
next_action.reason: Define window identity, cycling state, settings compatibility, and tests before approval.

judgment.rationale: The request identifies the existing Open app action and a bounded set of new behaviors for multiple windows and repeated activation.
evidence: The request compares the desired cycle experience to Win+number and lists explicit already-selected choices.
Keyboard Manager currently persists a ProgramAlreadyRunningAction enum with ShowWindow, StartAnother, DoNothing, Close, EndTask, and CloseAndEndTask.
The engine currently discovers processes by executable name and ShowWindow does not maintain per-shortcut cycle state.
judgment.recommended_action: Produce a detailed design for enumerating eligible top-level windows and cycling them deterministically per mapping.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager's Open app action should cycle among an application's windows and offer configurable behavior when the selected app is already foreground.
known_information: The proposal asks for repeated shortcut presses to advance through multiple windows.
Current settings expose only process-level already-running actions.
CreateOrShowProcessForShortcut identifies applications by executable name and does not model individual window selection.
inferences: The feature requires stable top-level-window enumeration and per-mapping cycle state, not only another enum value.
Packaged apps, multi-process applications, virtual desktops, minimized windows, and elevated windows may require distinct eligibility rules.
issue_context.analysis: The feature is suitable for design, but the previous approve_design action was premature because no root flow, affected-file plan, tests, or edge-case contract existed.
initial_investigation: Confirmed current behavior is process-oriented and lacks a window-cycle state machine.

information_gaps.information: Maintainer-approved definition of an application window set and cycle reset behavior
information_gaps.why_needed: It determines correctness for multi-process apps, virtual desktops, foreground changes, and repeated shortcut timing.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Resolve in the implementation design with explicit acceptance cases.
